title: CBB props: no player model and 'NBA and NFL only' publish rule, yet props are requested, priced and shown
steps: Read SPORT_DEFS.cbb: no propsFlag, so simulate.ts never runs a player sim for CBB and tick.ts never fetches player logs.
worker/src/publish.ts publishable(): returns 'props launch for NBA and NFL only' for any other sport.
worker/src/ingest.ts still requests PROP_MARKETS.cbb on every PropLine pull, so CBB props are priced (always consensus-only) and can reach edges_log / Edge Finder.
expected: One consistent story: either CBB props are launched (consensus-only, max grade B, labelled so) or the CBB Props tab says they are not offered yet.
actual: The CBB tab is shown with the generic empty state 'Books haven't posted props... Props appear here as soon as a book lists them', which promises something the publish rule says will not happen for picks. Edge Finder copy says 'A >= 5% with model and consensus agreeing' but no CBB prop can ever have a model.
evidence: Page text captured on the demo (empty state only; demo has no props). Code references above.
suspected_area: suspected: product decision not reflected in app copy; publish.ts vs ingest.ts/tick.ts flags
